core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mouloud is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Born, newborn”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mouloud corresponds to the Arabic form مَوْلُود (Arabic root و ل د (w-l-d); مَوْلُود (Mawlūd)). Its core sense is mouloud; born, newborn (amazigh form). Mouloud is the North African form of Arabic مَوْلُود (Mawlūd), meaning 'born, newborn'.

persian.name: مولود
